message: ぶっ契り

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, everyone, that concludes this morning's practice.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thanks to so many of you participating, our singing is sure to go well. Let's all work together to make the Holy Night Festival a success!」
Misa's lovely voice echoes throughout the early-morning chapel.
Just as expected, the number of people wanting to sing hymns doubled overnight.
Regardless of grade or gender, Misa never faltered in front of the large crowd, leading the vocal coaching resolutely as choir director.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well now, since practice is all wrapped up, how about I hand out some throat lozenges? Take good care of your throats, everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyone who wants herb candy, gather 'round!」
In the chapel where the tension of practice has melted away, the curtain rises on a brand-new battle.
Chatting among themselves, the participants each take whichever they prefer between the throat lozenges and the herb candies.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you go, say 'aaah.'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Throat lozenge, chomp~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lick~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright, don't push--there's plenty to go around.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Herb candy, chomp~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Slurp~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahaha. Oh, honestly, you guys.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't eat both! You guys have zero loyalty!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, looks like Nanaka-san and I are tied.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For the final point... Yumil, where are you?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For the record, Tennouji-san headed over toward the confessional.」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mgh-mgh-mgh-mgh...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eddie, it's been two full days since then and you're still sucking on that jawbreaker... You're a man--no, a true man's man!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mgh-mgh-mgh-mgh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「So that's why you couldn't make a sound at all, Mukaihara-kun...」
The warning bell rings out, and all the participants head from the church to the new school building.
Misa and I stay behind, quickly locking up the chapel.

name: Misa
message: 「Okay, all done. Thanks for staying with me」

name: Synn
message: 「We're not finished yet」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Are we going to do it... this morning too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I want to... do it too...」

name: Shio
message: 「Do what, pray tell?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister? Sir Synn?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Sh-Sh-Shio, you were here!?」

name: Shio
message: 「That is most cruel of you to say. I duly attended morning practice today as well!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what she meant--if we don't head to the classroom soon, we're gonna be late」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, if we hurry, we shall make it in plenty of time. Surely that is why you two are still tending to leftover duties as well」

name: Synn
message: 「Well...」

name: Misa
message: 「Right?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have a request to make as an exorcist shrine maiden, and so I was waiting for Sir Synn to finish his tasks」

name: Shio
message: 「I have heard rumors that Sir Synn devotes himself to Demon Lord training every night」

name: Shio
message: 「I swear I shall never be a hindrance to you, so I beseech you--would you please allow me to accompany you in your training as well!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun trains until pretty late at night, you know? Your parents will worry, Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「Father and Mother are away at a Shinto clergy gathering and will not return for some time. Sir Synn, I implore you!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh, sure. I don't really mind」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Sakura-kun!?」

name: Shio
message: 「I am deeply grateful! I shall redouble my efforts and prove my worth during the Re-Crea crisis!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. Even Melilot-san wouldn't push Shio-chan too hard, I'm telling you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, if you say so...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm coming to watch tonight too. A-And I'm not cheering you on or anything! I'm only accompanying Shio, got it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Crap!」

name: Shio
message: 「We are late, indeed...」

name: Melilot
message: 「With that, we shall conclude tonight's training.」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Lady Melilot is... a-a demon...」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan...」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You've been taking training brutal enough to make Shio pass out every single night with a straight face?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't really think of it like that, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is only natural that you would not realize it. As the Demon Lord, Sakura-kun is growing stronger day by day.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Asukai-san, who managed to stay on her feet until the very end, is quite remarkable herself.」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmmgh, mmmgh... Father~ Mother~...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll carry Shio-chan home on my back. Misa, can you take her naginata?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, leave it to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp?! N-No, you can't do that!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you give her a piggyback ride, Shio's chest will press right against your back, Sakura-kun... I won't allow such a thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it'll have to be a princess carry, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Give her a piggyback ride!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmmgh, mmmgh, Sister~... An ogre disguised as a librarian is coming for us~...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the not-too-distant future, Asukai-san will surely become a keen blade capable of slaying demons. For now, however...」
Melilot-san suddenly leaned her lips close to Shio-chan's ear--

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm gonna eat you up~」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe. Well then, please excuse me.」
Carrying Shio-chan on my back, I walk home along our usual school route with Misa.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Aren't you going the wrong way? Isn't your house over there, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm coming with you as far as Asukai Shrine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Look at what time it is, okay? I'm not gonna jump Shio-chan or anything, I swear.」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. As if I'd ever suspect you of something like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen here, Sakura-kun--once we reach Asukai Shrine, who exactly do you think is going to change Shio's clothes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah...... sorry, please come with me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good, as long as you understand!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahahahaha.」

name: Misa
message: 「*Giggle*」

name: Synn
message: 「We're kind of weird, aren't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though Re-Crea is arriving in just a few days and might destroy this world, here we are laughing over something like this.」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as I'm with you, I'm confident I can laugh, get angry, and stay happy no matter what happens.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, me too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even now that I've become the Demon Lord, hearing that the world's in danger still doesn't really feel real.」

name: Synn
message: 「But your smile, Misa--that I understand completely.」

name: Synn
message: 「So I'll do my best to make sure that smile never disappears.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun......」

name: Synn
message: 「If fighting is what it takes to protect your smile, Misa, I'll gladly fight.」

name: Shio
message: 「I have heard your words loud and clear. Having spoken them, you must uphold them. It is a promise.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, you were awake!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes, I have been awake since just a moment ago」

name: Shio
message: 「...Even if it were you, Lord Synn, had you done anything to make my elder sister cry, I intended to cut you down, however...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hearing your words just now has put me at ease. My elder sister is a shameless woman, yet I entrust her to your care」

name: Misa
message: 「If you're going to say that, it's not 'shameless,' it's 'inexperienced'!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-It is roughly the same thing, is it not?」

name: Misa
message: 「They're completely different!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek!? My elder sister is in earnest. Lord Synn, please flee while still carrying me on your back!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Look, you're troubling Sakura-kun. Give it up and get off his back」

name: Shio
message: 「Grrr~」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Look, a crescent moon in the sky--」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not angry, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, about what you said earlier, there's just one thing you got wrong」

name: Shio
message: 「Do you speak of Lord Synn's resolve and his promise? I cannot fathom how I might be mistaken...」

name: Misa
message: 「...When you find someone you truly love, tears just naturally spill over. I'm sure you will too, Shio--」

name: Shio
message: 「I am a shrine maiden of Asukai who slays demons; I would never do such a thing as weep」

name: Misa
message: 「No. The day will definitely come when you can shed tears too, Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I do not understand...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I didn't understand either...」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't understand either, yet I cried」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh... Eeeh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even you, Sakura-kun... *giggle*, *giggle giggle giggle*」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahahaha」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm? Could it be that this one is a third wheel?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, I'm going to Sakura-kun's house to cook now」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Come eat with us too, Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes, I shall gladly accept the invitation!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa, even if you suddenly say that, my room is messy and I don't even have any ingredients」

name: Misa
message: 「As for ingredients, I've got them packed right inside my bag」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Paqy, say something to stop her too」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to me! I'll head back ahead of you and dispose of the Demon Lord's favorite porn books!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you have to blurt it out like that?!」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Porn books... Even though you have me... How could you...」

name: Shio
message: 「Shall I cut him down?」

name: Misa
message: 「Go right ahead」

name: Shio
message: 「As you command!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaahhh!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, it's all done. Eat up and enjoy」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh... This smell--it's meat, isn't it!?」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Synn-dono, that is far too vague...」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, it's admirable that you live on your own, but you only ever eat such meager meals」

name: Misa
message: 「Make sure you get some proper nutrition every once in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Misa!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's gotten pretty late, hasn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「...Won't your parents scold you for staying at my place so late at night?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, it's fine. I told you, I always eat breakfast with Father and Mother.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, let's eat.」

name: Shio
message: 「Thanks for the meal!」

name: Synn
message: 「Munch, munch... Delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Look, there's still plenty more. Make sure you eat up.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Elder Sister and Lord Synn look just like newlyweds!」

name: Shio
message: 「Should I start calling Lord Synn 'Elder Brother' from now on?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Shio, don't tease me! It's still too early for marriage.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if we have the wedding now, we can skip the engagement ceremony, right? We'd save money on an engagement ring.」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't allow it! I will not have penny-pinching calculations brought into our sacred ceremony!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... Obviously I was just joking\s02」

name: Shio
message: 「How heartwarming. Surely the two of you have already exchanged a lovers' pledge.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. Shio, Sakura-kun and I have actually shared our first kiss twice.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, twice, you say? What sort of passionate romance must one follow to encounter such a phenomenon?」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, I'm not telling!」
